title: Link procurement to conformance with published national profiles
requirements:
- Make national profiles, test artefacts and tooling Phase 1/early Phase 2 outputs
- Map test gates to procurement stages, contractual acceptance, deployment and major upgrades
- Offer adaptable tender and acceptance clauses
- Clarify that data models, profiles and conformance criteria must be developed or adopted nationally before serving as procurement specifications
- Provide guidance or an annex on structuring digital procurement within public financial management
- Make conformance mandatory only against published, versioned, testable profiles
- Add procurement anti-patterns relevant to interoperability
- Support smaller suppliers with test tools and proportionate evidence
